Define `_run_chunk(xs, outs)`: `y=F.conv2d(xs,self._s_w1c,None,1,1)`; `y=_ext.gn_silu_nhwc(y,self._s_g1,self._s_b1,eps)`; `y=F.conv2d(y,self._s_w2c,None,1,1)`; `_ext.gn_silu_res_nchw_into(y,self._s_g2,self._s_b2,xs,outs,eps)`. `xs=self._s_xc[i0:i1]` (batch slice of a channels_last tensor stays channels_last-contiguous) and `outs=self._s_out[i0:i1]` (contiguous NCHW slice).

Define `_run_pipelined()`: `cur=torch.cuda.current_stream(); self._s1.wait_stream(cur); self._s2.wait_stream(cur)`; `with torch.cuda.stream(self._s1): yA=F.conv2d(self._s_xc[0:4],...); self._evA.record(self._s1); <rest of chunk A: gn_silu_nhwc, conv2, gn_silu_res_nchw_into into self._s_out[0:4]>`; `self._s2.wait_event(self._evA)`; `with torch.cuda.stream(self._s2): _run_chunk(self._s_xc[4:8], self._s_out[4:8])`; finally `cur.wait_stream(self._s1); cur.wait_stream(self._s2)`. 8. Capture: `self._graph=torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(); with torch.cuda.graph(self._graph): self._run_pipelined()`; sync; `_captured=True; _sig=sig`. Fork/join via wait_stream/record/wait_event is capture-legal and yields a parallel graph DAG.
